title: LRU Cache for Map Tiles (byte budget)
hints: Classic O(1) LRU: `std::list<Entry>` ordered MRU→LRU plus `std::unordered_map<TileKey, std::list<Entry>::iterator, TileKeyHash>`.
get: find in map; on hit, `lru_.splice(lru_.begin(), lru_, it->second)` moves the node to the front without invalidating iterators or copying data.
put: if the key exists, update bytes_ and the data, then splice it to the front. Else push_front and insert into the map. Then evict from `std::prev(lru_.end())` while `bytes_ > budget_`.
Oversized tile (size > budget): erase any existing entry for that key and return without inserting. Erasing the map entry and the list node keeps both structures consistent.
